resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1918 Maine Forest Service map calls the site Wesley Hill (Wesley Mt. or Day Hill). The Forest Lookouts page for Wesley Mountain, in Washington County, appears to describe the same tower. Treated as one site; not confirmed on the ground.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. We have only the 1910 listing, the 1920 inventory and a 1918 map. No build date, staffing history, access or closure information. Searches surfaced Facebook posts (a 2006 photo of the Wesley tower off Route 9 / Airline Road, and a 'Days Hill' mention) that could not be read, so their details are not used. Confirm the Day Hill / Wesley Mountain identity and current access on the ground or with the Maine Forest Service before publishing any visit guidance.
